params.body:
`elixir.json` declared `https://www.sportbusinessgame.eu` as production, and that address answers 301 to `https://sportbusinessgame.eu`. Elixir sent `/api/elixir` there with the bearer token, got the redirect, and its new credentials measurement read that as "the app refused the token; it was probably rotated on one side only". The token was right all along; the address was not. The canonical the site itself chooses is the one to declare.

The other half (a redirect on `/api/elixir` must be named as a redirect, not blamed on the token) goes to Elixir.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: elixir.json: production is sportbusinessgame.eu, the address that answers
